name: Disha Resources Limited
about: Disha Resources Limited engages in the trading business in India. The company trades in metal items such as coils, sheets, and plates; jewelry; motor blowers and condensers; copper pipes and fittings; grey and finished cloth fabrics; and stocks. It also engages in the business of industrial supplies, including precious and semi-precious metals; logistic services; trading of waste paper and textiles; recycling of paper; and coal and coal-related products. The company was formerly known as Arihant Avenues and Credit Limited and changed its name to Disha Resources Limited in March 2017. Disha Resources Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
